fusions.name: Shoal of Needles
fusions.desc: Looses 3 stings in a spread; each one deals 3 damage and has a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after.

fusions.name: Through the School
fusions.desc: A thrown sting that deals 12 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach, and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target then spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Slick Scales
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to slide off and be sent back to whoever laid it.

fusions.name: Missed Then Stung
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 4. The next ability you use spends them all, and you deal +6% damage per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 8 seconds.
